final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode-connected nfet sinks IREF
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* tail current source (~2x IREF)
MT  tail ibias vss vss nfet W=8 L=1
* NMOS input pair (vinn side drives the mirror diode -> vinp non-inverting)
M1  d1 vinn tail vss nfet W=6 L=0.5
M2  n1 vinp tail vss nfet W=6 L=0.5
* PMOS mirror load
M3  d1 d1 vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
M4  n1 d1 vdd vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS current sink
M6  vout n1 vdd vdd pfet W=24 L=0.5
M7  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=24 L=1
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  n1 nz 3000
Cc  nz vout 1e-12
.ends dut
